verdict.rationale: Hardware security-key vendors can plausibly ship developer APIs or SDKs, so this axis applies to Titan. The evidence shows no versioned API surface and no documented deprecation policy. A runtime probe found Titan ships no vendor CLI, SDK, API, or MCP surface of its own; fleet management runs through the separate Workspace Admin console. The CTAP1 compatibility mentioned in the docs comes with no API versioning or deprecation documentation.
